newsitem.title: FRANCE: "Napoleon's crown" vanishes from Corsica museum.
newsitem.headline: "Napoleon's crown" vanishes from Corsica museum.

text.p: A gold crown celebrating the 100th anniversary of the start of French emperor Napoleon's reign has been stolen from a museum in his native Corsica, the Ajaccio town hall said on Friday.
Guards realised the 1.8 kg (four lb) crown had vanished when they were closing Ajaccio's Napoleonic museum on Thursday, the town hall said.
Known as "Napoleon's crown", it was made in 1899 -- long after the emperor died -- to celebrate the centennial of his coming to power in a triumvirate.
